goal.title: Goal
goal.body: Every colour has 21 pieces. Get as many of them onto the board as you can: every square left off the board is a minus point, and placing all your pieces earns 15 points (and 5 more if the last one was the single square). The most points wins.

turn.title: A turn
turn.body: Your first piece covers your own starting corner. After that every piece must touch your colour at a corner, but never along a side. Other colours may be touched freely. With no moves left, your turns are skipped. For now a piece is placed by tapping a marked corner square; Hint shows where the bot would place a piece.
